checks.titleEn: E2E Networks database clusters have automated backups enabled
checks.condition: E2E Networks database clusters should have automated backups enabled so data can be restored after failures, corruption, or accidental deletion. Automated backups capture point-in-time copies of the cluster on a recurring schedule.
checks.remediation: Enable automated backups on every database cluster that does not currently have them configured, and validate that backups can be restored.

checks.titleEn: E2E Networks database clusters do not use the default admin username
checks.condition: E2E Networks database clusters should be configured with a custom administrative username instead of the well-known default, reducing the predictability of privileged credentials.
checks.remediation: Replace the default administrative username on database clusters with a unique, non-default account name and rotate the associated credentials.

checks.titleEn: E2E Networks database clusters with public IPs have IP whitelisting configured
checks.condition: E2E Networks database clusters that expose a public IP should restrict connectivity through an IP whitelist instead of accepting connections from any address (0.0.0.0/0).
checks.remediation: Configure an IP whitelist on publicly exposed database clusters to allow only trusted source ranges, or move the cluster onto private networking.

checks.titleEn: E2E Networks database cluster master nodes do not expose a public IP
checks.condition: The master node of each E2E Networks database cluster should be reachable only over private networking and must not have a public IP address assigned.
checks.remediation: Remove the public IP from the master node of database clusters and access them through private networking such as a VPC.

checks.titleEn: E2E Networks database clusters are in RUNNING status
checks.condition: E2E Networks database clusters should be in the RUNNING state, confirming they are operational rather than stopped, failed, or stuck in a transitional status.
checks.remediation: Start database clusters that are not in the RUNNING state and investigate the root cause of any stopped or failed clusters.

checks.titleEn: E2E Networks database clusters have SSL enabled on the master node
checks.condition: E2E Networks database clusters should require SSL/TLS on the master node so that client connections and credentials are encrypted in transit.
checks.remediation: Enable SSL/TLS on the master node of database clusters to encrypt all client connections in transit.

checks.titleEn: E2E Networks database read replicas do not have a public IP assigned
checks.condition: E2E Networks database read replicas should be reachable only over private networking and must not have a public IP address assigned.
checks.remediation: Remove the public IP from database read replicas and route access through private networking.

checks.titleEn: E2E Networks ALB HTTPS load balancers use an SSL certificate
checks.condition: E2E Networks application load balancers serving HTTPS traffic should have a valid SSL certificate configured so client connections are encrypted and authenticated.
checks.remediation: Attach a valid SSL certificate to every load balancer that serves HTTPS traffic.

checks.titleEn: E2E Networks ALB load balancers have backend health checks enabled
checks.condition: E2E Networks application load balancers should have HTTP health checks configured for their backends so traffic is only routed to healthy nodes.
checks.remediation: Configure HTTP health checks for ALB backends so unhealthy nodes are automatically removed from rotation.

checks.titleEn: E2E Networks load balancers have BitNinja protection enabled
checks.condition: E2E Networks load balancers should have BitNinja protection enabled to provide web application firewall coverage on public endpoints.
checks.remediation: Enable BitNinja protection on load balancer appliances to strengthen web application firewall coverage.

checks.titleEn: E2E Networks floating IPs are attached to nodes
checks.condition: E2E Networks floating (reserved) IP addresses should be attached to a node instead of being left unassigned, since idle floating IPs can be reassigned unexpectedly.
checks.remediation: Attach unassigned floating IPs to the intended node, or release them if they are no longer needed.

checks.titleEn: E2E Networks public or addon IPs are attached to a resource
checks.condition: E2E Networks public and addon reserved IP addresses should be attached to a resource, identifying orphaned addresses that remain internet-reachable without an owner.
checks.remediation: Attach orphaned public or addon IPs to a resource, or delete them to remove unused internet-reachable addresses.

checks.titleEn: E2E Networks VPCs have attached nodes
checks.condition: E2E Networks VPCs should have at least one node attached, identifying unused network segments that may indicate misconfiguration or forgotten resources.
checks.remediation: Attach nodes to VPCs that are in use, or remove empty VPCs that are no longer required.

checks.titleEn: E2E Networks VPCs are active
checks.condition: E2E Networks VPCs should be in the active state so that attached workloads retain expected connectivity and network isolation.
checks.remediation: Activate VPCs that are inactive so dependent workloads keep their expected connectivity and isolation.

checks.titleEn: E2E Networks VPC peering does not use external peers
checks.condition: E2E Networks VPC peering connections should be established only with internal networks and must not extend trust to external peers outside the account.
checks.remediation: Remove VPC peering tunnels that connect to external peers to keep private networks within trusted boundaries.

checks.titleEn: E2E Networks nodes have accidental protection enabled
checks.condition: E2E Networks nodes should have accidental protection enabled to guard against unintended deletion or modification of compute instances.
checks.remediation: Enable accidental protection on nodes to prevent unintended deletion or modification.

checks.titleEn: E2E Networks nodes have compliance mode enabled
checks.condition: E2E Networks nodes should run with compliance mode enabled so required security controls are enforced and workload activity remains auditable.
checks.remediation: Enable compliance mode on nodes to enforce required security controls and maintain auditability.

checks.titleEn: E2E Networks nodes have disk encryption enabled
checks.condition: E2E Networks nodes should have disk encryption enabled so data stored on node volumes and snapshots is protected at rest.
checks.remediation: Enable disk encryption on nodes to protect data at rest on volumes and snapshots.

checks.titleEn: E2E Networks nodes do not have a public IP assigned
checks.condition: E2E Networks nodes should not be assigned a public IP address, keeping compute instances off the public internet unless inbound access is explicitly required.
checks.remediation: Remove public IP addresses from nodes that do not require inbound internet access and reach them over private networking.

checks.titleEn: E2E Networks nodes do not have rescue mode enabled
checks.condition: E2E Networks nodes should not be running in rescue mode, which grants elevated filesystem access and can bypass normal operating controls.
checks.remediation: Disable rescue mode on nodes once recovery tasks are complete to restore normal operating controls.

checks.titleEn: E2E Networks nodes are attached to a VPC
checks.condition: E2E Networks nodes should be attached to a VPC so their traffic benefits from network isolation and segmentation controls.
checks.remediation: Attach nodes to a VPC to enforce network isolation and segmentation for their traffic.

checks.titleEn: E2E Networks security groups do not allow all traffic
checks.condition: E2E Networks security groups should not have an all-traffic rule, which permits unrestricted inbound and outbound network access.
checks.remediation: Restrict security group rules to the required ports and sources only, removing any all-traffic rule.

checks.titleEn: E2E Networks security groups do not allow inbound all-protocol traffic from any source
checks.condition: E2E Networks security groups should not allow inbound all-protocol traffic from any source (0.0.0.0/0), which opens every port to the internet.
checks.remediation: Replace overly permissive inbound rules with least-privilege rules scoped to specific ports and trusted sources.

checks.titleEn: E2E Networks nodes do not rely on permissive default security groups
checks.condition: E2E Networks nodes should not rely solely on default security groups that have overly permissive inbound rules.
checks.remediation: Attach custom security groups with least-privilege rules to nodes instead of relying on permissive defaults.

checks.titleEn: E2E Networks block volumes are not orphaned
checks.condition: E2E Networks block volumes in the Available state should be attached to a node rather than left provisioned without an owner.
checks.remediation: Attach Available block volumes to nodes, or delete unused volumes after confirming the data is no longer needed.

checks.titleEn: E2E Networks EFS volumes have backup enabled
checks.condition: E2E Networks EFS shared file systems should have backups enabled so data can be recovered after failures or accidental changes.
checks.remediation: Enable backups on EFS shared file systems to allow recovery after failures or accidental changes.

checks.titleEn: E2E Networks EFS volumes restrict VPC access
checks.condition: E2E Networks EFS volumes should restrict access to specific VPC resources instead of allowing every resource in the VPC to connect.
checks.remediation: Restrict EFS volume access to specific VPC resources instead of allowing all resources in the VPC.
